svg.text: A257 -- the SEAM: the 14 near-Trump siblings of the aligned descent to the tube (pad g1, delta_pin 1e-2)
Each panel is ONE aligned cut at the tube wall. The shaded half is the sibling the ordinary rules must kill; the clear half holds the Trump image and is where the spine descends to TUBE-KILL.
Green = the sibling died (rule named). Red = it did not die inside the wall -- that panel IS the seam gap (delta_LP < delta_basin there). Grey = not run.
